promoted_ranges.name: RESET_BOOTSTRAP_COPIED_PAYLOAD_SUFFIX_002DE
promoted_ranges.semantics: The final ten bytes of the reset routine's 38-byte post-table copy into Z80 RAM. The surrounding copy is a confirmed operation; the internal meaning of this payload suffix is intentionally not assigned.

promoted_ranges.name: RESET_BOOTSTRAP_POST_COPY_HARDWARE_VALUES
promoted_ranges.semantics: The reset path reads two longwords at 0x2E8 and 0x2EC through the VDP control pointer, reads a third longword at 0x2F0 through the same pointer, and writes the four bytes at 0x2F4 through 0x2F7 to the post-copy VDP data-base destination.

conclusion: Two formerly unknown startup gaps now have exact ownership based on direct reset-path consumption. The unconsumed 0x000002F8-0x00000313 tail remains deliberately open for a later Z80/bootstrap investigation.
